evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries urgent, negatively valenced insistence — a forceful directive to erase knowledge.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Sweeping 'Remove all knowledge' with exhaustive enumeration signals high-arousal insistence pressing for total erasure.
Flat declarative denial delivered without intensifiers or urgency — settled, low-arousal negation carrying negative valence.
